blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Laguna de Bay’s water level continued to decline given the dry conditions linked to El Niño, dropping to 11.60 meters as of 2 p.m. on Monday (November 23), according to the Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA). LLDA has set 10.50 meters as the lake’s critical-low level and 12.50 meters as its critical-high threshold Laguna de Bay last breached the critical-high threshold on October 2, when its water level reached 12.52 meters.
